messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick heads up — launching a docs style & snippet policy next week (aiming for Mon 2024-06-17). Main points: every code snippet in SDK/docs must include a one-line security note, a short license attribution (if copied), and a minimal runnable example for the primary language. Docs CI will start surfacing warnings, then move to enforcement. See rollout plan below.
DocBot: Automated checklist we’ll enforce: [license, runtime, example, security-note, tags]. Bot will open PR suggestions for trivial fixes.
Sam Park: Timeline? will this break a bunch of old PRs?
Ana Rivera: Two-phase rollout: 1) Advisory = CI shows WARNs for 2 weeks (auto-fix PRs suggested by DocBot). 2) Enforcement = CI FAILS on missing fields. We’ll only flip to enforcement after fixes and training session.
Miriam Li: Need legal signoff on the exact phrasing for the "security note" — looping in Priya.
Priya Kapoor: Quick read — we prefer a short neutral template. Suggested default: "Security note: Avoid sending unredacted PII to the API; mask or remove sensitive fields before submitting." We can include a slightly stronger variant for enterprise-sensitive pages.
Jia Chen: For SDK samples, do we have canonical templates for js/python/go/rust? I can add them to the samples repo if we land on a template.
Luke Gomez: Will require a small updates to docs-lint (snippet-metadata checker). I’ll open an infra PR to add checks and the advisory flag.
DocBot: Action: created draft PR #1234 to add security-note to /docs/sdks/js/quickstart.md (auto-suggestion).
Sam Park: :thumbsup: nice. How do teams request an exemption?
Ana Rivera: If a snippet truly can't be runnable (large fixture, long-running job), add the label `docs-exempt` with a short justification in the PR body. Docs leads will review weekly.
Miriam Li: Any UI for this? e.g., show warning badge on pages missing runtimes?
Ana Rivera: Good ask — docs console will show a small badge next to pages in the docs portal. Also we’ll surface token-level metrics later (not part of this rollout).
Ana Rivera: Example security note we expect in snippets: `Security note: Do not log user inputs; remove or redact PII before sending to the API.` Put that on the same line above the snippet.
Jia Chen: I’ll add js/python/go templates tonight with that note included.
Luke Gomez: PR to docs-lint opened: redacted-snippet-check + advisory mode flag. Will link once ready.
Priya Kapoor: Legal sign-off provided for default template. If anyone wants tweaks for country-specific wording loop legal.
DocBot: Reminder set for Friday 2024-06-14 10:00 UTC — 30m sync: "Docs snippet policy rollout Q&A" — invites to #docs and all SDK owners.
Ana Rivera: Thanks all — please skim the advisory branch and add feedback. We’ll keep the advisory mode for two weeks before flipping the enforcement gate.
Sam Park: ACK.
Miriam Li: ACK, will review the draft templates.
Jia Chen: ACK, filing the samples PRs now.
Luke Gomez: ACK — will monitor CI results.
